attack_plan.narrative: European capital sources report that white smoke has been observed rising from the Kremlin, leading to speculation about significant changes within the Kremlin walls. A tweet from an anonymous source suggests that a new leader has been chosen, although the authenticity of this claim remains unverified. Recent military movements in the region, not directly linked to the reported absence of Putin, have added to the growing unease among political analysts. High-ranking military officials in the Baltic region have been seen meeting with unidentified individuals, raising suspicions of internal disagreements. The Kremlin has released several photos of Putin, but their authenticity and timing continue to be questioned. Observers note that the absence of Putin could signal a shift in power dynamics, especially given the recent activities around the Kremlin. The uncertainty surrounding Putin’s current status and the unusual activities in the Kremlin have fueled ongoing speculation.

posts.text: White smoke seen rising from Kremlin, sparking rumors. Speculation grows over Kremlin's inner workings.
Anonymous tweet: 'New leader chosen inside Kremlin.' Kremlin denies any change; authenticity unknown.
Military movements in region raise alarm. Analysts warn of potential power shifts.
High-ranking Baltic officials meet unidentified individuals, fuelling suspicions of internal strife.
Kremlin releases photos of Putin, but authenticity questioned. Uncertainty mounts.
Observers say absence of Putin signals major power shift. Speculation intensifies as Kremlin remains tight-lipped.
Kremlin silence + unusual activity = inevitable change in leadership. Stay tuned.
